description: Open a Chat…: a list of the Claude Code chats on this computer; the one picked is read in a tab of its own. Dialog 560 wide, 620 tall, with its own header bar.
opens: the Open a chat… button of an empty chat tab

parts.name: title
parts.shows: "Open a chat" in the dialog's header bar.

parts.name: search box
parts.shows: A search entry, placeholder "Search chats", filtering as you type: a chat stays if the text is in its title or its folder (case-insensitive).

parts.name: chat row
parts.shows: A boxed list of rows, newest used first (the last 80 transcripts Claude Code keeps, by when they were last typed in; those the Claude desktop app replaced with a continuation are left out; a transcript with no title is left out). Each row: the chat's title; under it a dimmed subtitle "{folder} · {time ago}" (the folder with ~ for home; "No folder (Claude Desktop)" for a desktop app's scratch workspace); hovering the time shows the full date and time. A chat written to within the last 3 minutes has a green bold "live" tag at the right.

actions.does: Closes the dialog and opens the chat on a Read tab (RecordRead); one open already is shown.

states.name: loading
states.shows: A spinner while the chats are listed.

states.name: nothing matches
states.shows: The list is hidden (blank under the search box).
